title: Zero-ration camping still allows sustained recovery through the campaign deadline
reproduction: Start a fresh campaign on current main, repeatedly use Camp at Hearthwick, allow rations to reach 0 on Day 7, then continue camping to Day 19. The party remains able to camp and finishes at 0 rations, Fatigue 0/6 and 93% health.
player_impact_summary: The supplies loop can be largely bypassed by repeatedly camping with no food, weakening expedition pressure and making the 18-day clock easier to waste without a sustained survival trade-off.
notes: Matches existing Mechanist task LR-0016; no duplicate task created. Current main is slightly harsher than the LR-0021 historical baseline (93% rather than 100% health), but the core no-ration pressure loophole remains.
